sentences.ko: 아구스는 한밤중 문을 세게 두드리는 소리에 깼어요.

sentences.text: Wati suka mendengar ketukan hujan di atap seng rumahnya.
sentences.en: Wati likes hearing the tapping of rain on her house's tin roof.
sentences.ko: 와티는 집 양철 지붕을 두드리는 빗소리를 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Langit-langit unit Agus punya balok kayu yang sengaja dibiarkan terlihat.
sentences.en: The ceiling of Agus's unit has wooden beams deliberately left exposed.
sentences.ko: 아구스네 집 천장에는 일부러 드러나게 둔 나무 들보가 있어요.

sentences.text: Angin kencang menjatuhkan balok kayu dari gudang tetangga Wati.
sentences.en: Strong winds knocked a wooden beam off Wati's neighbor's shed.
sentences.ko: 강풍에 와티 이웃집 창고에서 나무 들보가 떨어졌어요.

sentences.text: Agus memasang gantungan baju di balik pintu kamar.
sentences.en: Agus put up a clothes hanger rack behind the bedroom door.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 방문 뒤에 옷걸이를 달았어요.

sentences.text: Wati menggantung lonceng angin di gantungan dekat jendela.
sentences.en: Wati hung a wind chime on the hook near the window.
sentences.ko: 와티는 창가 고리에 풍경을 달았어요.

sentences.text: Agus akhirnya membeli mesin pencuci piring karena malas mencuci sendiri.
sentences.en: Agus finally bought a dishwasher because he's too lazy to wash dishes himself.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 설거지가 귀찮아서 결국 식기세척기를 샀어요.

sentences.text: Wati membeli sabun pencuci baju khusus agar pakaian tidak bau apak saat musim hujan.
sentences.en: Wati bought a special laundry detergent so clothes don't smell musty in the rainy season.
sentences.ko: 와티는 우기에 옷에서 쿰쿰한 냄새가 나지 않게 전용 세탁 세제를 샀어요.
